capabilities: collect linked and backlinked notes to a configurable depth
visualize relationships between collected notes in an interactive graph
show note count and word count statistics for the collection
copy the context bundle to the clipboard
save the bundle as a Markdown file in the vault
extras: The README does not show a settings or troubleshooting section beyond the feature list; developed by Jeffry.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to pull a note plus its linked neighborhood into a single context bundle to paste into an external AI chatbot.
summary: AI context gatherer that collects notes connected by links or backlinks and exports the bundle for external AI chatbots.
